leadText: (Japanese: ポケモンバトリオ めざせ! バトリオマスター Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!) is a series based on the arcade game Pokémon Battrio. It is created by Takashi Teshirogi. The manga is about Ryū Tendō, who is trying to become a Battrio Master.
